fact: The project lead states that, after 12 months, a pilot of the central criminal file was launched at the Commissariat central and 8 urban commissariats and the provincial one in Kinshasa, entering investigation reports remotely over VPN into a central server (post of 12 April, dated 2022-04-13).
title: Ce mardi 12 avril, l'ambassadeur de France a inauguré au Commissariat central le service du Fichier Criminel des Incidents et Auteurs Présumés
